background_job.network_rule: Use a server-independent working route. The automatic job must not depend on the user's PC proxy or client staying online.
background_job.failure_policy: Record stage errors and pending paths;publish other available results. Do not re-run physics to create videos or endlessly restart training/upload. A failed push keeps the local commit for a later ordinary retry;never force-push.
background_job.resume_publication: Continue the same job's finish only after a concrete delivery error;reuse videos,snapshots and explicit Release destinations without re-running training/evaluation.
background_job.postprocessing_release_policy: New unassigned nonempty assets go to deterministic per-job partNN Releases,max900assets each;retain all existing manifest/index destinations and reuse already published files.
